channel.title: Tripwire — alerts
channel.description: Three signal packages — ASX, global, momentum — where the weights add to 100% by construction, so "combined" is arithmetic and not a promise. Every tier names the sectors it covers — crypto, US equities, ASX equities, indices (S&P 500, Nasdaq), commodities and FX, 31 markets — how many market tokens you can arm, and the live desk book: each leg marked hourly with its entry, last, move and band. Each package ships with its live combined move, a live graph drawn from our own hourly reads, the research note behind the weights, and an hourly alert when the basket itself moves past its ±% — on a hash-chained log you can verify. Paid hourly email; free quotes, feed, board and desk book.
